utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Right, I’m still catching up on the repair drive—where should I drop off the tool kit, and I’ll try to swing by later today.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah — I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let you know if anyone’s able to help. I’ll also pass along the best drop-off spot for the tool kit.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — just let me know the drop-off spot when you can, and I’ll bring the tool kit by. I’m still a little behind, but I’ll try to make it later today.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ve got my toolbox and I’m ready to help with the shelf and the loose fence board. Just point me to the first fix, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — start at the shelf by the front porch, then head to the loose fence board along the east side. I’ll keep track and let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Perfect — I’ll start at the front porch shelf, then head over to the east-side fence board and keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes — we’re still on, and I’m helping coordinate with Opal while Vik spreads the word. I’ll check the drop-off spot details and get them to you right away.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great — send me the time and address when you have it, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the time and address as soon as I confirm them. Thanks for being on board!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll ask around while I’m out and come back with the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Ira — that helps a lot. Once you’ve got the time and place, send it over and I’ll keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — I’ll check in while I’m out and send you the time and place as soon as I’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We’re still short on tape, screws, and a couple extension cords, and I’m keeping the list updated. If you spot any extra tools or parts, I can add them right in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm who’s coordinating and where the drop-off spot is?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m coordinating the list, and you can drop things off at my place for now. If that changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Gus — it’s been steadily filling up, so going early still sounds like the best move. Hope you find a few useful things there!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for a drill and a few screwdrivers, and I can bring the hammer by too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect — a drill and screwdrivers would be a great score, and bringing the hammer helps a ton too. Let me know if you spot anything else handy while you’re there!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Sam — send me the confirmed repair times and I’ll keep them clear of pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the confirmed repair times as soon as they’re set.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — once you send them, I’ll slot everything around the school run and avoid any conflicts.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—just tell me what needs fixing first, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’m still waiting on the drop-off details before I can plan my part, but I’m happy to help once that’s clear.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds fair, Pia—once the drop-off details are clear, I’ll follow along and bring what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, yes — the repair drive. I’ll bring the boxes over and take another look at the notice if I need to double-check anything.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you could bring the boxes by later today, that would help a lot—just let me know when you’re on your way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — I’ll bring the boxes by later today and let you know when I’m on my way.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the porch steps or the leaky faucet. I’ll come by early and see what’s left.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m still catching up, but I’ll pass along anything I hear about what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Nell — just let me know if the bike chain or anything else still needs work.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks — send me the exact time by text, and I’ll work around pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s Saturday from 10 to 2 at my garage on Maple, and I’ll text you the full details now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — I’ve got it. I’ll plan around 10 to 2 and wait for your text with the details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you still need most for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mina — we’re still looking for a few handy volunteers and basic tools, and I’ll post the updated details now that it’s Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — should I share the updated volunteer and tool list with anyone else?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No problem, Sam — I’ve got the drill and screwdrivers covered; if you have a hammer, we’re set for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect — I can bring a hammer, and that should cover us nicely for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, then we’re all set — I’ll bring the drill and screwdrivers, and we can meet up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still on for the repair drive, but can you confirm who’s coordinating with Opal and where the drop-off spot is?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping the repair-drive list updated, and Rosa is coordinating the next steps. I’ll note the drop-off location as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — thanks. Can you confirm the drop-off spot as soon as it’s set?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What do you still need most?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Mostly just the drop-off spot details and any last-minute updates. I’m checking those now and will pass them along as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—just send the drop-off details when you have them, and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m on my way with my toolbox, and I can take care of the shelf and the loose fence board—just point me to the first thing that needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—thanks, Mara. I’m by the house; just text me when you’re close and I’ll point you to the shelf first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: On my way now—I’ll text you when I’m close and head straight for the shelf.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it — I’m still catching up, but I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — I’ll wait for the full details before I plan anything.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sounds good — I’ll do the same and let you know if I hear anything new.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I’ll text you the exact time and address soon.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — send me the time and address when you can, and I’ll try to swing by with my toolkit later today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo — I really appreciate it. I’ll send the details soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes—please send the confirmed time and the full list of what we’re bringing, and I’ll treat it as set once I’ve checked those details.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure — I’ll send the confirmed time and the full bring list so we can lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll wait for that and then I’ll consider it confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great — once you send the confirmed repair times, I’ll line everything up around pickup and drop-off and flag any conflicts right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, I’ll confirm the repair times and send them over so you can line up pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect — send them over when you have them, and I’ll make sure we stay clear of pickup and drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sounds like the drive is still buzzing—good time to go while the best supplies are still out. Hope you find something handy, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — the repair drive’s now on Sunday at the community center, so I’ll keep everyone posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, Sunday at the community center makes it easy to remember — thanks for the update, Rosa. I’ll pass that along and hope folks still find plenty of useful supplies!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll ask around while I’m out and let you know what I find on the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — that’d help a lot. I’m still a bit fuzzy, but I’ll check the notice again and can bring the boxes over if needed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — if you spot anything on the notice, let me know, and I’ll keep asking around while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — the repair drive is Saturday from 10 to 2, and you can drop things off at my garage on Maple. I’ll send the full details now!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll stop by Saturday and see what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — thanks, Rey. The leaky faucet by the side sink is still first, then the loose porch step, and I’ll keep everyone posted.
